clue.text: Severely criticised extremely abrupt change of course by journalist

explanation.walkthrough: In ALTITUDES the L (liberal) is swapped for T (time), giving ATTITUDES.
explanation.definitionFit: An attitude is a settled way of thinking about something, which is a viewpoint.

clue.text: Related to Churchill's last daughter

explanation.walkthrough: 'Related to' reads as kinship, but 'Related' alone is the definition, in the sense of a story recounted.
explanation.definitionFit: To relate a story is to tell it, so related and told are the same past tense verb.

a rate of pay

explanation.definitionFit: To pull together is to work jointly toward a goal, a common idiom for co-operating.

clue.text: Finished up in crowded neighbourhood

explanation.definitionFit: Ended and finished are synonyms for something having come to a close.

tall in the sense of big or great
odds measure chances

explanation.definitionFit: An outcome achieved against all odds is one nobody expected, an idiom for a surprising result.

these letters rearranged

taken as written

clue.text: One flower came up

blocks.note: a means one
a rose is a flower

explanation.surface: A single bloom pushing up through the soil.
explanation.definitionFit: Arose is the past tense of arise, meaning rose or came up.

clue.text: Get up late to provide extra rest

blocks.note: over in the sense of extra, left over
sleep is rest

explanation.surface: Advice to lie in bed longer for some additional rest.
explanation.definitionFit: If you oversleep you sleep past the intended time, so you rise late.

clue.text: During the night a city is silent
